698350101.text: ...This style has a certain lighthearted charm. I believe Ayaka would find it pleasing.

698350103.text: #Now, this is a fortuitous encounter, {NICKNAME}. I had previously pre-ordered a batch of fabrics from Ogura's, and they would typically be delivered to the Kamisato Estate for us to make our selection.

698350104.text: However, as I was already at Tenshukaku today for discussions with Her Excellency, the Almighty Shogun, I thought I might as well stop by and review them in person.

698350107.text: Were these meant for ordinary use, then they would naturally be handled by the relevant staff.

698350108.text: However, consideration for attire used in official functions begins with the fabric and colors. These I often see to personally.

698350109.text: After all... Given the Kamisato Clan's role within the Yashiro Commission, overseeing cultural and civil matters, even minor choices regarding textile patterns draw public scrutiny.

698350110.text: Many merchants market their products using "Yashiro Commission-approved" labels after our annual procurements.

698350111.text: I did once delegate the task, but... vendors rushed to offer my representative bribes, heh, and the temptation proved too much for him... It was no small matter to resolve.

698350112.text: I have personally overseen such matters since. A stitch in time saves nine.
